verses.text: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.

xrefs.text: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.

Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.

verses.text: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

xrefs.text: Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.
Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.

verses.text: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?

xrefs.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
“I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

“Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple— the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight— see, He is coming,” says the LORD of Hosts.

verses.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.

xrefs.text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

verses.text: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.

xrefs.text: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.

verses.text: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

xrefs.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.

Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may rest on grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring— not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.
When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

xrefs.text: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
“Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.
The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

verses.text: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

xrefs.text: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts— He is the King of Glory. Selah

xrefs.text: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
“He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”
